description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans silo metadata configuration, retrieval, and synchronization across a cluster. It defines test classes, fixtures, and extension methods to verify the correct behavior of silo metadata handling in an Orleans testing environment.

classes.name: SiloMetadataTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for verifying silo metadata configuration, reading, setting, and cluster behavior in Orleans.

classes.name: SiloMetadataTests.Fixture
classes.description: Test fixture that sets up an in-process Orleans test cluster with specific silo metadata configuration.

methods.name: SiloMetadataTests.SiloMetadata_FromConfiguration_CanBeSetAndRead
methods.description: Verifies that silo metadata configured via app configuration can be read correctly across all silos.

methods.name: SiloMetadataTests.SiloMetadata_HasConfiguredValues
methods.description: Checks that the configured metadata values are correctly stored and retrievable from a silo.

methods.name: SiloMetadataTests.SiloMetadata_CanBeSetAndRead
methods.description: Ensures that setting silo metadata programmatically results in consistent metadata across silos.

methods.name: SiloMetadataTests.SiloMetadata_NewSilosHaveMetadata
methods.description: Tests that newly added silos have the expected metadata after cluster expansion.

methods.name: SiloMetadataTests.SiloMetadata_RemovedSiloHasNoMetadata
methods.description: Verifies that when a silo is removed, its metadata is cleared or absent.

methods.name: SiloMetadataTests.SiloMetadata_BadSiloAddressHasNoMetadata
methods.description: Checks that querying metadata for an invalid silo address returns empty metadata.

methods.name: SiloMetadataTestExtensions.AssertAllSiloMetadataMatchesOnAllSilos
methods.description: Extension method that asserts metadata consistency across all silos in the cluster for specified keys.
